metadata.description: Polaris: a personal Claude Code marketplace with skills, agents, commands, hooks and MCP servers, packaged as installable plugins.

plugins.name: polaris-documentation
plugins.description: Documentation helpers: structured, reviewer-friendly pull request descriptions generated from the branch diff.

plugins.name: polaris-monitor
plugins.description: Monitoring and alerts: beeps when Claude finishes, asks a question or needs permission, a usage and context status line, and a window that tracks every session.
